narrative.overview:
The page is a field guide to one sky, after the 1896 International Cloud Atlas. A fixed sky sits behind everything: a pale zenith fading into high clear air, three planes of cumulus and wisp roughened by fractal noise, and a warm horizon haze that rises in as the visitor reads down toward contact. Content either sits straight on that sky or is mounted on white plates, the way specimens were mounted in an atlas, with an italic Fraunces caption beneath.

Density is low and the pace is slow. Sections are separated by space, never by rules or bands. Hierarchy comes from the contrast between a high-contrast Didone display set large and a plain, sturdy grotesque for everything you read or press. One accent, dusk violet, marks only what moves or can be clicked.

The world exists in two lights from the same tokens. By day: pale blue air warming to peach haze. By night: deep ink-blue sky, moonlit cloud at low opacity, and a faint violet afterglow at the horizon.
keyCharacteristics: One fixed, layered sky behind every screen, including 404 and error.
White plate mounts with a fine inner keyline and a long daylight shadow.
Fraunces Moda for display, headings and italic captions; Hanken Grotesk for body and UI.
Dusk violet only on interactive or moving things.
One shared hover grammar: 0.4s on cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1).
Exactly one scroll-driven animation: the sky descent.

rules.name: The Moving Edge Rule
rules.body: Dusk violet appears only on something that can be clicked, focused, typed into or selected. If an element is static, it is ink, never violet.

rules.name: The Two Lights Rule
rules.body: Every colour is a token with a day and a night value; nothing is hard-coded per mode. Clouds drop to 12-20% opacity at night so the sky reads as dark air, not grey fog.

rules.name: The Caption Is Italic Rule
rules.body: Anything that annotates a specimen (what it is, what it was built with, where the person is) is Fraunces italic in muted ink. Labels for controls stay in the grotesque.

rules.name: The Regular Weight Rule
rules.body: Fraunces is set at 400 everywhere, with `font-optical-sizing: auto`. Emphasis in display comes from italic, never from bold.

rules.name: The Daylight Rule
rules.body: Shadows always fall downward with a negative spread and are tinted with Shadow Blue. No hard offsets, no grey, no glow on static surfaces.

rules.name: The One Descent Rule
rules.body: The page has exactly one scroll-driven animation: the GSAP timeline that moves the far plane by 18%, the mid plane by 55% and the near wisps by 125% of the viewport height across the whole scroll, and fades the horizon haze from 0 to 1. Nothing else animates on scroll. Under reduced motion the sky holds still with the haze at half.

dos: **Do** mount featured work and grouped specifics on plates: Plate Mount, 1.25rem radius, inset Keyline, Plate shadow.
**Do** caption every specimen in Fraunces italic, muted ink.
**Do** keep Dusk Violet on interactive elements only (The Moving Edge Rule).
**Do** use the shared Motion hover on every link and button: 0.4s, cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); pills lift 2px into the Lift shadow, text links draw their underline in.
**Do** keep nested radii concentric: 1.25rem plate, 10px mount, 0.875rem inner.
**Do** separate sections with space (96px, 144px from `md`), not rules.
**Do** keep the sky visible behind every full-screen state, and hold it still under reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** add a second scroll-driven animation; the sky descent is the only one.
**Don't** set Fraunces bold or use a system display face; emphasis in display is italic.
**Don't** use neutral grey or hard offset shadows; shadows are Shadow Blue and fall softly downward.
**Don't** lift plates on hover; only pills lift.
**Don't** fill the inner keyline or leave it as an empty panel; it frames real content (title, caption, description, links) on bare plate.
**Don't** build a grid of identical project cards; lead with mounted plates and put the rest in the ruled index.
**Don't** add stat counters or invented metrics.
